title: Counit of the first line with the identity compositor
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-affine-ordered-integration-data], a scheme Y and a separated finite-type structure map aY:Y→Spec(k). Let K be a bounded-below pro-etale coefficient complex with ordinary constructible finite-Tor representative Ke and realization eK. Let q:A¹_Y→Y be the last projection at stage zero and p=q;id_Y. Write gamma=lineComparison and c=identityCompositeMap as in [def-pur-affine-space-comparison], and b=standingEvaluation as in [lem-pur-affine-line-composite-transpose]. Let w be the inverse lower-shriek congruence isomorphism at lineSource(K) associated to (q;id_Y=q).symm. Then F_p(gamma;c);epsilon_p,K = w;b, with F and epsilon the standing compact support and restricted exceptional counit. This uses the single-line normalization [lem-pur-affine-line-standing-transpose], with the identity-compositor equality transport retained on both sides; no ordered recurrence is assumed.

proof.text: Prove compatibility of the counit with equality transport by substitution. Apply it to q = q followed by id, then use lineComparison_counit and the definition of identityCompositeMap.

theorem lineComposite_counit (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] [IsSeparated aY]
    (K : Plus (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y)
    (Ke : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y)
    (hKe : etaleFiniteTor (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y Ke)
    (eK : (comparison (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) Y).obj Ke ≅ K.obj) :
    letI : IsNoetherian Y := tower_noetherian P Y aY 0
    letI : IsNoetherian (iteratedAffineLine Y 0) := tower_noetherian P Y aY 0
    letI : HasCompactification (lastProjection Y 0 ≫ 𝟙 (iteratedAffineLine Y 0)) :=
      HasCompactification.of_eq (f := lastProjection Y 0) (Category.comp_id _).symm
    (AffineLineEvaluation.support P aY (iteratedAffineLineProj Y 1)).map
        (lineComparison P Y aY K Ke hKe eK ≫
          identityCompositeMap (AffineLinePurity.Ring P) (lastProjection Y 0) K.obj) ≫
      rightDerivedUpperShriekCounit (iteratedAffineLineProj Y 1) K.obj K.property =
    (rightDerivedLowerShriekCongr (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AffineLinePurity.Ring P))
      (Category.comp_id (lastProjection Y 0)).symm).inv.app ((lineSource P Y).obj K.obj) ≫
      AffineLineEvaluation.standingEvaluation P Y aY K.obj Ke hKe eK
